output.summary: The Board is adopting a resolution approving a $26,375,121 California Department of Education contract for the California State Preschool Program, run by the District's Early Childhood Education Department. The contract covers July 1, 2025 to June 30, 2026.

output.headline: Accepts $7,500 state contract for the Prekindergarten and Family Literacy Program

money.evidence: in the amount of $7,500.00

output.summary: The Board is adopting a resolution approving a $7,500 California Department of Education contract for the Prekindergarten and Family Literacy Program, run by the District's Early Childhood Education Department. The contract covers July 1, 2025 to June 30, 2026.

output.headline: Ratifies up to $39,932 for Kitchen Guard to clean kitchen hoods at about 55 school sites

money.evidence: in an amount not to exceed $39,932.00

output.summary: Kitchen Guard of SF/Heredia cleans kitchen hoods, filters and exhaust ducts at about 55 school sites to keep ventilation and fire protection working, for Nutrition Services. The agreement covers November 1, 2025 to June 30, 2026 and was ratified after the service period began.

output.headline: Hoot Reading to give one-on-one literacy tutoring to 160 summer school students at no cost
output.summary: Hoot Reading, Inc. will provide one-on-one, high-dosage literacy tutoring to 160 students at 4 summer school sites at no cost to the District. The agreement runs June 1 to July 31, 2026, through the Community Schools and Student Services Department.

output.headline: Pays an artist up to $15,000 to lead a community mural at Elmhurst United Middle School

money.evidence: in an amount not to exceed $15,000.00

output.summary: An individual contractor will lead a project to turn a medium-sized wall at Elmhurst United Middle School into a collaborative artwork reflecting the school community's values and diversity. The agreement runs April 1 to June 30, 2026, and the Board is ratifying it.

output.headline: Pays a music instructor up to $20,000 for band, choir and percussion at Montera Middle School

money.evidence: in an amount not to exceed $20,000.00

output.summary: An individual contractor will teach performing arts at Montera Middle School, including band, choir and percussion, with a focus on brass instruments, weekend academies and evening recitals. The agreement runs April 1 to June 13, 2026, and the Board is ratifying it.

output.headline: Pays The People's Conservatory up to $20,000 for hip hop arts and filmmaking at Emerson Elementary

money.evidence: in an amount not to exceed $20,000.00

output.summary: The People's Conservatory will offer an arts program in hip hop arts and filmmaking at Emerson Elementary School, as described in the agreement's Exhibit A. The agreement runs December 8, 2025 to May 28, 2026, and the Board is ratifying it.

output.headline: Pays East Bay Consortium up to $25,500 for college aid workshops and advising at Sojourner Truth

money.evidence: in an amount not to exceed $25,500.00

output.summary: East Bay Consortium will hold Cash for College workshops to help families complete federal and state financial aid applications. It will also provide one-on-one advising, classroom presentations and transcript reviews for seniors in the Sojourner Truth Independent Study Program. The agreement runs February 26 to June 30, 2026.

output.headline: Pays Quiet Curtains up to $38,002.37 to replace stage curtains at Oakland High School

money.evidence: in an amount not to exceed $38,002.37

output.summary: Quiet Curtains will sell, remove the old stage curtains and install new curtains with new hardware at Oakland High School. The agreement runs January 20 to May 29, 2026, and the Board is ratifying it.

output.headline: Pays Carter-Kelly Consulting/LifePoint up to $21,000 for dropout-prevention support at Oakland Tech

money.evidence: in an amount not to exceed $21,000.00

output.summary: Carter-Kelly Consulting/LifePoint will coordinate services to reduce the dropout rate and help students at risk of not graduating at Oakland Technical High School. This includes workshops for students and families on attendance, goal-setting, planning after high school, and finding school resources. The agreement runs March 1 to May 29, 2026, and the Board is ratifying it.

output.headline: Pays Coastal Current Conservatory up to $25,923 for Skyline High's musical production

money.evidence: in an amount not to exceed $25,923.00

output.summary: Coastal Current Conservatory will provide three teaching artists to work with the school's musical director and stagecraft teacher on rehearsals and a full production of “The Lightning Thief” at Skyline High School. The agreement runs January 5 to May 28, 2026, and the Board is ratifying it.

output.headline: Pays Djola, LLC up to $28,183 for an after-school STEM and basketball program at East Oakland Pride

money.evidence: in an amount not to exceed $28,183.00

output.summary: Djola, LLC will run an after-school academy for 2nd and 3rd graders at East Oakland Pride Elementary School, twice a week for 90 minutes. It combines LEGO robotics, science labs and sports activities. The agreement runs January 13 to May 28, 2026, and the Board is ratifying it.

output.headline: Ratifies the minutes of the April 22, 2026 regular Board meeting
output.summary: The Board is ratifying the written minutes of its regular meeting of April 22, 2026, prepared by staff after the meeting. No money is involved.

output.headline: Orders layoffs of permanent classified employees for lack of work or funds in 2026-27
output.summary: The Board is asked to accept a proposed decision from the Office of Administrative Hearings and order the layoff of permanent classified (non-teaching) employees for lack of work or lack of funds, under Education Code section 45117. The title ties the action to the 2026-2027 school year. The text gives no dollar amount and no number of employees.

output.headline: Stanford to train staff on youth substance-use interventions at no cost, with a student data sharing agreement
output.summary: Stanford University will train OUSD staff and researchers to use research-based interventions for youth affected by substance use or the justice system, and will deliver them and study the results. A separate data sharing agreement sets rules for how the District shares student data with Stanford and how Stanford protects it. Both agreements are at no cost to the District, and the services run April 24, 2026 to June 30, 2028.

vendor.name: Board of Trustees of the Leland Stanford Junior University

output.headline: Ratifies the district's appeal of the county's "Going Concern" financial designation to the state
output.summary: The Board ratifies a protective appeal the district filed with the State Superintendent of Public Instruction. The appeal challenges the Alameda County Office of Education's April 16, 2026 "Going Concern" designation, under Education Code section 42127.6. The text states no dollar amount.

output.headline: Approves salary schedules for SEIU Local 1021 workers under a deal running through June 2027
output.summary: The Board approves salary schedules for members of Service Employees International Union (SEIU) Local 1021, which includes the Oakland School Employees Association and the Oakland Child Development Paraprofessional Association. It also covers public disclosure of the financial documents required by state law (AB 1200). The tentative agreement covers November 1, 2024 through June 30, 2027 and refers to an earlier Board action dated February 25, 2026. The text gives no dollar amounts.
